source: Built from packages/course-data/.cache/soc-202701.json (Spring 2027 Schedule of Classes) in the main checkout, the only Schedule of Classes snapshot cached anywhere in this repo (see SOURCES.md and MAPPING_NOTES.fixture). Limited to the course ids @turboterp/tracks actually names. A course not being offered that one term doesn't make its number invalid: BSCI161, BSCI171, BSCI330, PHYS141, PHYS142 and PHIL170 aren't in it but are each named directly by another already-fetched UMD page (see their own notes); CHEM146, CHEM177 and CHEM247 aren't in it and have no confirming source either, so their credits/title are this builder's best guess and the owner should verify the numbers themselves before relying on them. Batch C added BMGT221, BMGT310, BMGT311, BMGT321, BMGT323, BMGT326, BMGT340, BMGT411, BMGT417, BMGT422, STAT401, STAT410, PHYS171, PHYS270, PHYS272, PHYS273, PHYS401, PHYS404, PHYS411 and PHYS420, with titles and credits from the Academic Catalog approved-course pages (checked 2026-09-29).
